english.note: Use this after an action verb when the action has been completed in full, as in 做晒 for “finish it all.”

exampleSentences.jyutping: di1 gung1 fo3 ngo5 zou6 saai3 laa3

english.note: Use this colloquial construction when an action is done to the whole amount or all relevant items, rather than to emphasize thoroughness.

exampleSentences.english: They completely ate all the fish on the plate.
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 sik6 saai3 dip6 jyu4 laa3
